d1e17.t: What is the UNBREAKcable Car FM Transmitter?
d1e17.d: This device is a simple plug-in car adapter that broadcasts audio over an used radio frequency on your car's radio and is used in older vehicles to provide modern streaming capabilities for music and hands-free calling. This device offers two seperate audio inputs and has seperate ports for charging.
